Stop prompting your AI coding assistant from scratch—ECC turns tools like Claude Code and Cursor into structured engineering teams with persistent memory, autonomous planning, and built-in security scanning.

Are you tired of AI drift, hallucinations, and constantly rewriting prompts to keep your coding assistant on track? ECC acts as an agent harness operating system that supercharges AI developer tools by introducing a coordinated workflow of planning, testing, reviewing, verifying, and remembering. It eliminates the need to rebuild these engineering constraints in every single prompt.

Key Features:
* Comprehensive ecosystem of 68 specialized agents, 286 skills, and 94 legacy command shims for architecture, security, and build repair
* Automated continuous learning and memory layers that persist critical project knowledge and turn repeated wins into reusable workflows
* AgentShield security scanning to protect your agent execution environments
* Cross-platform support and native installation hooks for Claude Code via npm alongside capability adapters for Cursor, Zed, and GitHub Copilot

Whether you are enforcing strict Test-Driven Development loops before production modifications or maintaining persistent cross-session memory across massive microservice codebases, ECC saves you significant time and token costs while keeping code quality high.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC

Render over 2,200 interactive 3D anatomical meshes smoothly right in the browser using React and Three.js! 🧬✨

Building data-dense 3D applications on the web usually means hitting a massive performance wall when dealing with thousands of separate draw calls. 

Human Atlas solves the challenge of rendering highly complex, multi-mesh biological datasets in real-time. It transforms the BodyParts3D adult male reference model into a fully interactive, searchable, and explodable 3D experience without sacrificing browser performance.

🔥 Key Features:
• High-Performance 3D Rendering: Merges geometry into batches and uses per-structure GPU textures for translation, visibility, and selection.
• Comprehensive Anatomical Data: Features 2,234 individually selectable meshes, 15 anatomical systems, and 3,432 searchable named concepts.
• Exploded View Layouts: Dynamically packs and spaces out visible anatomy pieces cleanly across desktop and mobile aspect ratios.
• Advanced Validation Scripts: Includes custom automated validation for mesh buffers, nonoverlapping layouts, search contracts, and tap-versus-drag interactions.

Whether you are building interactive educational web apps for medical training or implementing GPU-driven instancing and batching architectures for complex industrial digital twins, this repository is a masterclass in optimization. 

Explore the code and level up your 3D web graphics stack today:
https://github.com/ashemag/human-atlas

Tired of guessing your AI coding limits? Codenotch pins real-time usage meters for Claude, Cursor, and Codex directly to your Mac's screen edge.

Juggling multiple AI coding assistants shouldn't require constant context-switching to web dashboards or CLI commands just to check your rate limits and token quotas. 

Enter Codenotch: a lightweight macOS utility that aggregates usage limits and active session statuses from tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok into a unified, screen-edge-pinned heads-up display.

Notable Features:
- Zero-Sign-In Architecture: Safely borrows existing credentials, session states, and OAuth tokens directly from local app keychains, databases, and config files without repetitive permission prompts.
- Dynamic Edge Placement: Supports all four screen sides, automatically docking cleanly against the macOS hardware notch or dynamic Dock bounds.
- Real-Time Execution Tracking: Displays a spinning arc when a session is active and a pulsing amber alert when an assistant is blocked waiting for user input.
- Robust Failure Handling: Gracefully degrades to visible status indicators (stale, needsAuth, error) rather than guessing metrics when API limits hit.
- Clean Architecture Study: Built for developers interested in modular provider patterns, stack layout math, and native macOS tooling like xcodegen and Sparkle.

Stop getting caught off guard by rate limits mid-flow. 

Check out the repository here: https://github.com/vinzdg/codenotch

Tired of losing valuable business opportunities and unfulfilled promises buried deep inside chaotic messaging apps? 

Turn your chaotic local WeChat chat history into a searchable, privacy-respecting personal intelligence hub with automated daily briefings and AI agent skills. 

Wechat-Intelligence-Hub is a game-changer for AI engineers, indie hackers, and local-first developers. It solves information overload by locally processing and indexing your chat history. It extracts action items, unfulfilled promises, and relationship notes, rendering them into clean markdown logs and interactive HTML executive reports—all without sending a single byte of your private data to cloud services.

Here is why you need to check it out:
🔐 Clean-Room Local Reader: Supports schema-2 salt-key authorization and WCDB compressed messages safely without hooking into or modifying WeChat binaries.
📊 Dual-Output Dashboards: Automatically generates structured Markdown summaries and interactive HTML dashboards equipped with global search, topic filters, and radar views.
🤖 Native LLM Agent Integration: Features modular CLI tools and specialized skills for natural language queries regarding your past conversations and pending tasks.
🧠 Context-First Engine: Prioritizes context based on your personal objectives, active projects, and custom relationship tags.

For developers, this repo provides a clean architectural blueprint for building secure, local-first data ingestion pipelines that interface with encrypted mobile databases like SQLCipher. It is a masterclass in separating low-level data reading layers from high-level LLM reasoning.

🚀 Explore the code and build your own local intelligence engine today:

Stop building AI commerce agents from scratch and risking unapproved database writes. 🛑 Anthropic just dropped their official reference blueprint for production-ready shopping and merchant agents powered by Claude!

The anthropics/commerce-agents repository gives AI engineers and full-stack developers a complete, enterprise-grade architecture that bridges customer-facing storefronts with sensitive back-office operations. 

Here is what makes it a game-changer for your next deployment:

🛒 Dual-Agent Architecture: Deploy a customer-facing shopping agent for intelligent search, comparison, and cart building, alongside a back-office merchant agent for inventory, pricing, and campaign drafting.
🔒 Strict Safety Guardrails: Features built-in fencing, provenance gates, caps, and memory validation. Crucially, all merchant writes are staged for human review so autonomous tools never execute unapproved changes.
⚡ Multi-Runtime Support: Use the same core prompts and tools across Anthropic's Messages API, the Claude Agent SDK, and Managed Agents via Model Context Protocol (MCP).
🛠️ Claude Code Integration: Includes a dedicated commerce-builder plugin to scaffold, extend, and evaluate custom agents tailored to your exact tech stack.
🏢 Multi-Vertical Ready: Ships with four fully runnable industry verticals (Retail, Travel, Telecom, and Entertainment) featuring dedicated storefronts and merchant portals.

Whether you are embedding an intelligent shopping assistant or automating back-office workflows without exposing raw database access, this repository handles complex state management, session handling, and security boundaries out of the box.

👉 Check out the repo and start building: https://github.com/anthropics/commerce-agents
